body:
Slice of #5670 — this is acceptance criterion 3 of #5670 itself: "the eval harness runs from its new home with golden-311 parity."

**Run (from `pkgs/atlas-search/eval/README.md`):** on the laptop, from the in-repo `pkgs/atlas-search/eval/` directory:

```sh
~/atlas/v3-venv/bin/python eval3.py --mode fts --corpus ~/atlas/v3/corpus.db --queries fixtures/golden-311.json --out /tmp/golden-311-fts.json
```

The runner checks the frozen v3 fingerprint (101,471 chunks) before scoring. Record the headline metrics (hit rate / MRR) here and on #5670, and compare against the design record's Gate B parity numbers (py-scan Δhits 0, ΔMRR +0.0016 vs rs-scan, 2026-11-04).

**Gates:** amd-6 healthy (do not run during the disk-drain / reachability flapping seen 2026-11-23/24); respect the in-flight index-rewrite state — if the rewrite is still running, say so and wait rather than posting a degraded number as parity evidence.

**Acceptance:** run completes from the in-repo copy; metrics recorded on this issue and #5670; any mismatch vs Gate B is analysed, not silently accepted.
